title: Bloodline

location.name: Night Garden Field (Ancestors' Parade Ground)
location.kind: open night meadow on the rise above the shore, crossed by a processional path
location.real_analog: grass plain beside the Avenue of the Dead at Teotihuacan at night (processional causeway through open field, a short drive from the Mexico City Atlantis shoot); fallback: any dark rural meadow with a long footpath
near: Nevermore shore below (trail leads up from it)

situation: Still night. The POET, heart and hands restored at the end of Nevermore, walks on through the same field and into a welcoming parade of black, afro-futuristic ancestors. They accept him and hand him stars, galaxies and universes as the verse names them. The basement-bedroom childhood is staged only as memory (inferred: insert or tableau carried by the parade); no EX is present.
time_of_day: still night (continuous with Nevermore's night garden field)
weather_light: windless, muted trees, deep starlight; the gifts (stars, galaxies) are the main light sources; afro-futuristic photo-realistic grade. The verse's 'sun-kissing my skin' is a warm glow from the ancestors, not daylight (inferred)

set_pieces.name: The field goes still
set_pieces.what_happens: POET stands in the field with his newly restored hands; the parade's first figures appear on the path ahead (inferred blocking).
lines: They tell me to ask if I can inherit the earth
set_pieces.camera: wide static on the field at night, POET small at center, procession lights entering from the far edge
set_pieces.position: edge of the field where Nevermore ended

set_pieces.name: Naming stars
set_pieces.what_happens: Ancestors meet and accept the POET and hand him stars, then whole galaxies, as small held lights.
set_pieces.camera: medium tracking alongside POET as he walks into the parade; inserts of hands passing points of light
set_pieces.position: processional path, center of the field

set_pieces.name: Southern-pine basement (memory)
set_pieces.what_happens: The past 'was waiting': a humid basement used as a shared bedroom, mattress pads under pine beams that did not comfort his spine. Staged as memory, not a separate place (inferred).
set_pieces.camera: low-angle insert up at exposed pine joists, shallow focus, then match-cut back to the night sky
set_pieces.position: memory insert inside the parade passage

set_pieces.name: Universes and blessings
set_pieces.what_happens: The ancestors give him a universe to invent and the right to grant blessings and miracles where the spoken word is needed.
set_pieces.camera: slow push-in on POET's face as galaxies are placed in his hands; crowd of ancestors soft behind

set_pieces.name: Blood through the hands
set_pieces.what_happens: POET looks at the hands he just recovered in Nevermore; the ancestral blood and fingerprints now run through them. The parade's sound swells (inferred).
lines: their blood flows through my hands
set_pieces.camera: extreme close-up of palms and fingerprints lit by star-glow, rack focus to the ancestors
set_pieces.position: far end of the parade, facing toward the city

set_pieces.name: Baritone and warning
set_pieces.what_happens: His voice deepens to a baritone of a million cries; on 'beware' he turns from the parade toward the horizon where the Atlantis entrance waits (inferred).
lines: deepening my voice to a baritone of a million cries
set_pieces.camera: low-angle hero medium, POET turning out of frame toward the gate light
set_pieces.position: far edge of the field, at the trailhead to the gates

arrival.from_previous: Continuous from Nevermore: he puts his hands back on, stands in the night field, then keeps walking through the same field into the parade.

departure.to_next: Still night, he sees the entrance to Atlantis and goes in; the stretch from parade to gate is not written (inferred: he walks down the path, possibly escorted).

motifs: hands (restored in Nevermore, now carrying blood)
encoding: The field where he rebuilt himself becomes the place where he is claimed by lineage: the hands he recovered alone are filled with ancestral blood before he is allowed into the city. It must happen on open ground between shore and city because inheritance is the admission, so the parade is the gatehouse before the Light Gates (inferred). His poor beginnings (the basement) are answered with whole universes.
